pr.title: feat(checkout): Support loyalty discounts and voucher redemption [KAN-8]
pr.author: ntuteja

jira.summary: Implement Tiered Loyalty Discounts (VIP 20%) & Defensive Voucher Validation in Checkout Engine

acceptance_criteria.title: AC-1: CustomerTier.VIP_PLATINUM discount multiplier must be updated to 0.20 (20%). A $100 cart for a VIP customer must calculate a $20.00 discount and an $80.00 final amount.
acceptance_criteria.detail: AC-1: CustomerTier.VIP_PLATINUM discount multiplier must be updated to 0.20 (20%). A $100 cart for a VIP customer must calculate a $20.00 discount and an $80.00 final amount.

acceptance_criteria.title: AC-2: Vouchers must be verified for is_active == True. If a voucher exceeds max_discount_amount, the discount must be capped at max_discount_amount. Inactive or expired vouchers must not apply any discount.
acceptance_criteria.detail: AC-2: Vouchers must be verified for is_active == True. If a voucher exceeds max_discount_amount, the discount must be capped at max_discount_amount. Inactive or expired vouchers must not apply any discount.

acceptance_criteria.title: AC-3: Unit tests in tests/test_discount_service.py must be updated to validate the 20% VIP Platinum rate ($80 expected on $100), plus new test coverage for inactive voucher rejection and discount capping.
acceptance_criteria.detail: AC-3: Unit tests in tests/test_discount_service.py must be updated to validate the 20% VIP Platinum rate ($80 expected on $100), plus new test coverage for inactive voucher rejection and discount capping.

acceptance_criteria.title: AC-4: Each successful discount calculation must emit a structured audit log containing audit_event_id, customer_id, subtotal, and total_discount for financial compliance.
acceptance_criteria.detail: AC-4: Each successful discount calculation must emit a structured audit log containing audit_event_id, customer_id, subtotal, and total_discount for financial compliance.

review_findings.title: VIP Platinum 20% Discount Rate
review_findings.message: DiscountService.TIER_DISCOUNTS[CustomerTier.VIP_PLATINUM] is configured to 0.10 (10%) instead of required 0.20 (20%).

review_findings.title: Defensive Voucher Validation
review_findings.message: Missing validation for voucher.is_active and voucher.max_discount_amount cap. Inactive vouchers are erroneously applied.

review_findings.title: Unit Test Coverage & Assertions
review_findings.message: tests/test_discount_service.py test_vip_platinum_discount_legacy still asserts obsolete $90.00 outcome. Missing inactive voucher test cases.

review_findings.title: Structured Audit Logging
review_findings.message: No structured financial audit log emitted on successful discount calculation.
